ios.desc:
#1 app to use your phone wisely.
Tired wasting time on social media? Let's change this! 

Naze (from Japanese [なぜ] – "Why"), your ultimate companion in reclaiming control over your digital habits! 

You'll likely spend about 6 hours on your phone today. By using Naze and being more mindful and intentional about social media usage, you can enhance your focus and achieve your goals.

Our app specializes in reducing screen time by heightening awareness of impulsive app openings. 
Naze empowers you to make conscious choices about your digital interactions by slowing you down during unintentional app opens and prompting you to select the reason for opening the app.
Studies show that being aware of WHY you want to open the app reduces the likelihood of opening it.



Take back time that belongs to you from social media giants! 

Key Features:

Lock apps: After selecting which apps to lock, you won't be able to open them until you go through the unlock flow.
Set usage time: The unlock flow requires you to choose how long you need to use the app.
Select app opening reason: When attempting to open the app, select why you want to do so.

Take the first step towards a healthier relationship with your device. Download Naze now and embark on a journey to reclaim your time and focus!


Terms: https://naze.app/terms & https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
